tickets.title: Establish the standalone project
notes: Public foundation, provider-neutral architecture, pinned Node 24/npm 12 toolchain, and complete Apache-2.0 license verified.

tickets.title: Implement construction tracking and token monitoring
notes: The phase orchestrator exclusively owns this canonical checklist; raw usage stays ignored and only sanitized overlap-safe summaries are committed.

tickets.title: Prove required provider mechanics
notes: Bounded native launch/resume feasibility is met. Authenticated isolated execution remains a hard later-phase gate; unavailable native permission and cancellation receipts remain unsupported capabilities with truthful outcome classification, not universal admission requirements.

tickets.title: Freeze comparison fixtures
notes: Luna-medium produced the initial fixture set; evidence-driven review escalated remediation to Terra-high. Frozen expected-RED and base-GREEN contracts now reproduce under Node 24; no benchmark runs were performed.

tickets.title: Build the configuration model
notes: Strict TypeScript runtime sources resolve factory, product, optional pod, provider, budget, authority, environment, capability, and sparse-override behavior; the package emits JavaScript and declarations and the packed CLI is verified from a clean install.

tickets.title: Implement interview and resumable provisioning
notes: Discover-first onboarding now maps every answer to actual retained configuration, discovery, proposal, or explicitly pending fields. A completed example proves valid resolution, answer retention, proposal creation, and stale-approval invalidation; revision-bound, resumable local provisioning remains verified and remote effects stay unsupported.

tickets.title: Implement hierarchy and context assembly
notes: Stable hierarchy identities, cycle and reference rejection, planning/executable separation, immutable ancestor constraints, dependency contracts, and source-revisioned scoped context packets are verified without unrelated sibling material.

tickets.title: Author lifecycle skills and provider wrappers

owner.role: skills, entry maps, and examples specialist

notes: Eleven concise skills, proportional lifecycle packaging, stack-neutral examples, and deterministic provider entry maps are verified. Bootstrap semantic tests now validate every interview destination against the actual retained configuration, discovery, proposal, and pending-field contract.

tickets.title: Implement coordinator and durable run records
notes: Append-only JSONL is authoritative; exclusive coordinator ownership, semantic run/effect identity, reservations, messages, exact worker identity, terminal outcomes, recovery, and disposable SQLite reconstruction are behavior-tested. Unknown workers and usage remain blocked or reserved rather than inferred away.

tickets.title: Implement workspaces and execution profiles
notes: Digest-pinned isolated and explicit native plans, exact-env argv transports, PID/container identity probes, coalesced durable cancellation, continuous-identity native group escalation, output/runtime bounds, and Docker --rm log capture are implemented. Authenticated start, resume, and cancellation runs observed UID 65532, /workspace cwd, only the workspace and dedicated vendor-profile mounts, no Docker socket, host home, control storage, journal, or publisher credentials/environment, durable revocation before exactly one stop, and confirmed container absence. The owner-approved inner-sandbox override remained Docker-only, hardened-plan-bound, and disabled by default.

tickets.title: Implement the Codex adapter and local delivery loop
notes: The adapter and coordinator-owned single-worker path bind exact environment, cwd, model, current packet, durable source session, source factory/product/repository/workspace/provider scope, worker identity, events, final result, usage, and reservation disposition. Live authenticated evidence now proves a bounded fixture edit plus provider/local tests, exact-session same-scope resume without --last plus a second edit/test, explicit durable cancellation of a started long command, truthful interrupted_uncertain provider cancellation, confirmed container exit, unchanged cancellation workspace state, and succeeded/succeeded/cancelled projection recovery. Earlier failed attempts remain retained and demonstrate that terminal provider events cannot invent a workspace effect.

tickets.title: Implement controller-owned action admission
notes: Controller-minted per-run HMAC capabilities bind immutable scope, expected revisions, and current authority epoch. Durable cross-controller claims, restart-safe private verifier storage, effect-boundary revalidation, nonce/idempotency handling, and malformed/forged/stale/revoked denial are behavior-tested. No remote publication executor is present.

tickets.title: Implement the Claude adapter
notes: Claude transport, exact prompt authorization, explicit resume, native lifecycle, outcome normalization, and common delivery integration pass deterministic coverage. Corrected live start and exact-session resume completed; complete artifact text remained in the durable provider event while the diagnostic final summary stayed bounded.

tickets.title: Implement the Cursor adapter
notes: Cursor ACP transport, exact prompt authorization, request and notification handling, explicit session load, and confirmed process-group exit pass deterministic coverage. Unknown or mismatched initial identities quarantine without blind signaling. Corrected live implementation, executable verification, and exact-session load completed.

tickets.title: Implement team delegation and handoffs
notes: Bounded durable delegation, ownership, per-workstream allocation, exact-schema portable result evidence, artifact transfer, restart recovery, concurrent admission, and orphaned-admission repair pass deterministic coverage. The corrected live coordinator recovered handoffs across restart without duplication.

tickets.title: Prove role portability and provider substitution
notes: The corrected Claude to Cursor to Codex chain preserved the initial CHANGES REQUIRED review, recovered the complete Claude plan from the exact durable provider event, and reused the unchanged Cursor artifacts without rerunning either provider. A fresh Codex session accepted the exact plan, counter and verifier digests, and pre/post-review verification printed verification passed.

tickets.title: Implement GitHub integration
notes: Controller-owned gh operations reconcile provider effects and retain human merge authority.

tickets.title: Implement optional Jira integration
notes: Configured transitions fail visibly; explicit links preserve unsupported hierarchy.

tickets.title: Implement evidence-based progression
notes: Review and CI evidence is exact-head-bound; human merge authority is unchanged.

tickets.title: Implement deployment and maintenance entry
notes: Actual local deploy/smoke subprocesses and one durable smoke follow-up passed.

tickets.title: Build the Console shell and read views
Add owner actions and conversation controls
Verify supported host and stack paths
Run the paired comparison and finalize release evidence
